svg.text: The ADA node's protocol stack — three channels, one transport, one encoding
Two channels cross the network; the third never leaves the pod. Nothing here touches UPER, so the node carries no ASN.1 codec.
R2 in · V2X ECU to ADA
UTF-8 JSON · versioned · one JSON Schema per contract · one message per datagram or per line
one binding per side of the boundary
R6 — the CarSky Ethernet Bridge Node, one L2 segment 10.99.0.0/24
Everything from the encoding row down is shared by the two network channels. The process channel stops at the pod: it has no network and no link layer, which is the whole point of
joining the two processes by stdout rather than by a socket.
The frozen R3 schema is the shape on both the JSONL line and the object field of every R4 warning — one schema, two crossing points, so a perception source can be swapped without
Deliberately absent: Vanetza, because this node never sees a CPM; any database engine, because the assessment table is in process and its writes leave through the event stream.
tcpdump is the fourth channel and carries no message: capture.sh writes readable [CAP] lines and rotating pcap files, because R15 and R19 need a record of ADA-to-IVI traffic that
the V2X ECU's capture point cannot see.
